region.finding: All 24 enlarged baseline source and battle head/body slices actually inspected. Pointed muzzle, mouth edge and lower cheek flatten and stretch during alternate idle, recoil, attack and defeat; the side mouth contour becomes a thin horizontal projection toward the collar. Eyes, ears, blue headband, full green quill mass, tunic and belt, arms/hands and legs/feet otherwise remain coherent. Requires complete lower-face binding repair, preserving quills and torso motion.

All 24 enlarged baseline source and battle head/body slices actually inspected. Scaled snout, mouth and side jaw squash and stretch through alternate idle, recoil, attack, cast and defeat; terminal defeat pulls the face into a long thin wedge through the hood. Ears, eyes, wrapped hood, armor shell, all four legs and wraps, claws and segmented tail otherwise stay coherent. Requires complete face binding repair while retaining hood and body articulation.
All 13 original body/head animations visually inspected. Muzzle, lower face, skull or beak deformation confirmed by the dense anatomical probe; repair and final verification pending.

Viewed all 24 enlarged source and battle face/body front/side sheets for all 13 clips at six phases. Lower white muzzle, whiskers, mouth/chin and side jaw visibly stretch, gape and compress with the torso during alternate idle, attack, recoil, cast and defeat; the face sinks into the scarf during defeat. Eyes, ears, crown, headband/ties, tunic/belt, arms/hands, legs/feet and complete tail remain coherent. Repair must preserve the moving scarf and limbs.
